title: suderra.site-config.v1 site config
description: Signed by the config-integrity key, anchored in the trust-anchors bundle, device-bound and tenant-bound (ADR-048 DEC-3.3, DEC-4.10, DEC-4.12, DEC-22). It names every site file root installs under /var/lib/suderra-site by digest and size, and the RBAC manifest by statement digest and policy_version. In P0 it arrives only inside a provisioning delivery (delivery.json); from P1 the root update worker also accepts it on the request channel (kind=site-config). Root verifies it against the bundle's config-integrity anchor and writes it as site-config.dsse; the agent re-verifies it and compares every site file's digest before loading config.yaml (DEC-4.10). config.yaml is the agent's configuration document, bound here by digest; the per-event output behaviour table joins this statement with DEC-13 P1 (EDGE-HIGH-065) and the per-output policy with DEC-13 P2.

update_seq.description: Monotonic per device; an equal value is accepted only for the identical installed statement (statements.json sequences, DEC-4.10).

files.description: Every site file, keyed by its fixed path; config.yaml is always present. Root installs exactly these files and nothing else.

rbac_manifest.description: The suderra.rbac-manifest.v1 statement delivered with this site config (rbac-manifest.dsse), by statement digest and policy_version.
